newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche - Russia will issue Eurobond as planned.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche - Russia will issue Eurobond as planned.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Monday that Russia would issue its mark-denominated Eurobond as planned and that the exact time of the issue had not been decided yet.
The Russian finance ministry had on Friday already rejected reports that the Eurobond could be delayed.
A Deutsche Bank spokesman told Reuters in Frankfurt: "Russia will issue the bond on the German market as planned but there is no final decision on the timing yet."
